name: Fastenal
description: Fastenal distributes fasteners and industrial and construction supplies (safety, janitorial, tools, hydraulics, electrical, welding) made by other companies, through 1,595 branches, 15 regional distribution centers and on-site inventory at customer locations. Its edge is placing vending machines and bin-stocking programs (Fastenal Managed Inventory) inside customers' facilities, so resupply recurs automatically. About 96 percent of sales are products made by others; about 4 percent are products it manufactures or repairs. FY2025 net sales were $8,200.5 million with operating income of $1,655.7 million (20.2 percent margin).

employees.note: Full and part-time; 17,166 selling personnel (70.1%), 4,057 distribution/transportation, 1,046 manufacturing, 2,220 organizational support.

businessLines.name: Industrial and construction supplies distribution (single reportable segment)
businessLines.how: Resale of third-party supplies at a markup, sold by branch staff and through vending/bin programs at customer sites, with recurring replenishment.

brands.name: Holo-Krome
